content:
Voice orb (hands-free)

Full-screen-style voice session: listen → transcribe → respond; states include idle, listening, transcribing, thinking, speaking.

What this is

The voice orb starts a hands-free loop: listen, transcribe, think, then respond (spoken or in chat depending on your setting). Status text under the orb tells you which phase you are in.

How to use it

  • Open the orb from the composer or header control (per your build).
  • Wait for Listening, then speak naturally; pause briefly to end a phrase.
  • Tap the orb to cancel long transcribe/think/speak phases when shown.

Notes and limits

Bluetooth headsets add latency; if transcripts cut off, pause slightly longer between sentences.
